identitySignals: Name matches: 'Emergency Rooter Construction' (erplumbingsfbay.com) and 'Emergency Rooter' (BuildZoom, CSLB license 729165), based in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location
Website describes general engineering, plumbing, utility and sewer lateral (PSL) work, matching OUSD's sewer lateral repair, kitchen plumbing and lead abatement agreements for school buildings
OUSD Legistar file 25-2121 names 'Emergency Rooter, Oakland, CA' for the District-Wide Lead Abatement Project (plumbing pipe, fixture and sink work at school sites)
research.notes: BuildZoom lists the business structure as sole ownership (a business operating under a trade name). The only general email on the site is a named person's address, so email was left null. Address comes from BuildZoom and search results, not the company's own site. A Yelp listing 'Emergency Rooter & Plumbing' (closed) at 801 98th Ave, Oakland appears to be an older listing. No Secretary of State, EIN or SAM.gov record was found.

profile.summary: Emergency Rooter Construction is a licensed general engineering contractor based in Oakland, California. It describes itself as building infrastructure and providing utility solutions, including plumbing and sewer work, across the San Francisco Bay Area for over 30 years.

review.notes: The Legistar file 25-2121 names Emergency Rooter, Oakland, CA for plumbing and lead abatement work at schools. That matches the Oakland CSLB #729165 general engineering contractor on erplumbingsfbay.com and BuildZoom. The summary, phone, address, headquarters and orgType are supported and neutral, and the named-person contacts were correctly left out.
